title: MM-SHAP: A Performance-agnostic Metric for Measuring Multimodal Contributions in Vision and Language Models & Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Applying MM-SHAP, a metric based on Shapley values, to calculate the proportional contribution of individual modalities (textual degree vs. visual degree) to model predictions on Vision-and-Language tasks, identifying whether a model disproportionately relies on a single modality.

Evaluating models on foiled instances (e.g., the VALSE benchmark) where textual cues represent highly frequent, plausible, or stereotypical concepts from training data (like small numbers in counting) that contradict the visual input, and measuring how much the model relies on these textual priors over actual visual evidence.
